fieldNotes.operationalStatus: OPERATIONAL. The only BlueTriton/Primo/Nestle Waters presence in Livermore is the water distribution/branch facility at 7480 Las Positas Rd, Livermore CA 94551 (37.7119,-121.7033), in the Las Positas business park east of the airport. This is the entry that appears as 'Livermore Factory' on the BlueTriton/Primo list. Status confirmed via three lines of evidence: (1) Dec-2024 Street View of the truck-yard side shows an actively used, chain-link-fenced paved yard holding box trucks, delivery vans and trailers; (2) the live Yelp page for ReadyRefresh at 7480 Las Positas was updated Mar-2026 with 71 reviews (active water-delivery operation); (3) satellite shows three large water process/storage tanks on the building's east side plus trailers backed to docks and a full trailer drop yard. NOTE: Google Places carries a stale duplicate ReadyRefresh listing flagged CLOSED_PERMANENTLY at this same address, while a parallel 'Arrowhead Bottled Water Delivery Livermore' listing at the identical address shows OPERATIONAL - this is a duplicate-listing artifact, not a real closure; no WARN notice or news of a Livermore shutdown was found. CAVEAT on TYPE: physically this reads as a distribution/depot + light water-processing branch (single ~120k sqft 1991-era big-box with three exterior tanks), not a large dedicated high-speed bottling plant like the Cabazon/Sacramento factories. The list labels it 'Bottling plant (PL)'; kept that label per instruction but the on-the-ground footprint is depot-scale.
fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords were UNKNOWN. Web search established BlueTriton/Primo's only Livermore site = 7480 Las Positas Rd 94551 (Buzzfile, LoopNet, Yelp, Google Places). Geocoded that address to 37.71179,-121.70326 and confirmed the building on satellite: a long NW-SE big-box with three white process tanks on its east face, dock band + trailers on the SW/south, a fenced trailer drop yard to the north, and trailers along the west apron. Locked center 37.71185,-121.70330.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. Dec-2024 Street View on the internal business-park road (pano ic9zwDVsNfyga_MQ03dsXw) shows a chain-link perimeter fence around the truck yard with a sliding/rolling vehicle gate; a white box truck/van sits just inside the gate. The yard side is controlled, distinct from the open landscaped office frontage on Las Positas Rd (no control there). Gate confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at the fenced gate in the Dec-2024 Street View or in satellite. The gate is unstaffed.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE. A truck gate exists (sliding chain-link gate) but there is no guard shack, implying badge/kiosk/remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Building SW/south face shows a row of dock positions with ~6 trailers/box-trucks backed in plus dock-leveler shadows; honest estimate ~8 doors -> banded 0-10. Low confidence; could touch 10. Pallet stacks are staged on the SW apron.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE. A dedicated fenced trailer/vehicle drop lot sits at the NW/north of the building (neat rows of ~16-20 box trailers in the z18 wide view), separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking area to the north holds ~16-20 trailers without tractors -> banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~16-20 in the north drop yard + ~6-8 along the west apron / backed to docks = ~28. Mixed imagery vintage; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Drop-yard rows + west apron could practically hold ~40 trailers.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~5.5 acres for the BlueTriton-controlled footprint (building + west apron + north fenced drop yard) inside the shared business park, derived from the perimeter polygon. The broader park is larger but multi-tenant.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban. Site sits inside a dense industrial/business-park fabric in east Livermore (Bay Area metro, Alameda County), surrounded by warehouses and offices.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE. Dense metro business park, strong cellular coverage expected.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE (medium confidence). The paved yard between the gate, the drop rows and the dock face acts as an internal queue/staging area inside the fence before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: The gate-to-dock approach is short (the dock face is ~1-2 truck-lengths inside the fenced yard); marked drivewayShort, not drivewayLong.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. A single dock cluster on the SW/south face; no second distinct dock bank for split ship/receive.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the site is road-served only. FALSE.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One primary BlueTriton/Primo big-box building (with attached exterior tank farm); neighboring big-boxes are separate tenants -> 1.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path. FALSE.
fieldNotes.streetView: Front (office/parking) frontage on Las Positas Rd captured 2019-06 (open, ungated). Internal truck-yard road captured 2024-12 (pano ic9zwDVsNfyga_MQ03dsXw) shows the fenced gate and active yard - used for both perimeter and truckGate streetViewMeta.
